method: Verified SHA-256, byte size, PDF readability and the actual 24-page count.
Rendered and visually reviewed all 24 pages, including the side-by-side table, selected EGLE Work Order pages, Merit reports, Cyclopure reports and EGLE transmittal letter.
Matched the supplied binary exactly to the established 1140 Plett comparison-packet record and reused its existing browser-local preview and full download.
Linked the established packet directly to the AOI event and labeled the evidence as multi-agency testing by EGLE, Merit and Cyclopure.
Retained the open evidence requests for the complete 49-page work order and chain-of-custody forms.

canonicalRecord.name: 2025-09-10 - EGLE Cadillac Comparability Study Source Packet - 1140 Plett Road.pdf

findings: The packet compares nine primary September 10, 2025 method-and-condition combinations plus an EGLE duplicate for unflushed indoor, three-minute-flushed indoor and outdoor samples.
The summary also carries forward a March 7, 2025 Cyclopure test and June 24, 2025 EGLE resample for 1140 Plett Road.
The summary reports PFOA results from 19.3 to 35 ng/L and PFOS results from 9.3 to 19 ng/L across the displayed rounds.
The packet contains only selected pages from EGLE Work Order 2509147 and no chain-of-custody form.

queueResolution.reason: The multi-agency results strengthen the repeated Plett receptor record, but the packet remains only 24 of 49 work-order pages and does not supply a chain-of-custody or field sheet for the September 10 sampling.
